description: This file defines the JspViewHandler class, which handles rendering of JSP views within the Apache OFBiz web application framework. It includes methods for initialization, view preparation, and rendering, utilizing servlet APIs and custom utility classes.

classes.name: JspViewHandler
classes.description: A view handler class that manages rendering JSP pages in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with the servlet context.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares and returns the context map for the view rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Handles rendering of a JSP page, including obtaining the request dispatcher and including the view, with error handling for IO and Servlet exceptions.
